purpose: Measure fixed-workload successful request throughput within preselected latency targets; no optimization or live provider generation.

environment.shared_host: Docker Desktop and native k6 share the 4-CPU/8-GiB WSL2 host; normal k3s deployment remains running
environment.background_activity: Normal k3s demo remains running; correctness tests and other benchmark generators stopped before this series.

workload.target: Direct loopback HTTP; excludes Traefik, TLS, Funnel and frontend rendering.

frozen_targets.applies_to: Each of the five routes independently
frozen_targets.reason: Both 5 RPS baselines have worst-route p95 below 19 ms and p99 below 31 ms. These fixed local interactive API targets allow scheduling variance while keeping tails below 250 ms; they are not a production SLA.

units_and_limits.service_latency: seconds, interval means and interpolated histogram percentile estimates; includes client/backend scheduling
units_and_limits.resources: CPU cores and bytes; mean/sample maxima from five-second samples
units_and_limits.cache_hits: Preloaded synthetic analysis; enforced hits do not estimate organic hit rate
units_and_limits.capacity: Five-minute shared-host private-fixture observations; not live-cluster or long-duration capacity
units_and_limits.historical_ai_generation: Old 6.5-second generation figure was not verified and supports no speedup claim
